UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointment made by the Governor of Uva Province

BY virtue of powers vested to me under Section 154F(1) and (5) of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution of the DemocraticSocialist Republic of Sri Lanka, I, M. P. Jayasinghe, Governor of the Uva Province do hereby announce that I have made thefollowing appointment of the Provincial Council of Uva Province with effect from 13th February 2015.

01.Hon. Harin Fernando-Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Peace, Education, LocalChief Minister of the Uva ProvincialGovernment, Social Welfare, Rural Infrastructure Development andCouncilConstruction of the Uva Provincial Council.
M. P. JAYASINGHE,Governor of Uva Province.Office of the Uva Governor,Badulla,13th February 2015.
